items.q: Which level of the classification system is the broadest?
items.qAf: Watter vlak van die klassifikasiestelsel is die breedste?
items.explain: The kingdom is the broadest level; the species is the most specific.
items.explainAf: Die koninkryk is die breedste vlak; die spesie is die mees spesifieke vlak.

items.q: Which two names make up a binomial name?
items.qAf: Watter twee name vorm ’n binomiale naam?
items.explain: Binomial names use the genus and species, for example Homo sapiens.
items.explainAf: Binomiale naamgewing gebruik die genus en die spesie, bv. Homo sapiens.

items.q: A bacterium has no nucleus. In which kingdom is it placed?
items.qAf: ’n Bakterie het geen kern nie. In watter koninkryk word dit geplaas?
items.explain: Bacteria are prokaryotes and are placed in the kingdom Prokaryotae.
items.explainAf: Bakterieë is prokariote en word in die koninkryk Prokaryota geplaas.

items.q: Which kingdom has multicellular organisms with chitin cell walls that absorb their food?
items.qAf: Watter koninkryk het meersellige organismes met chitien-selwande wat hul voedsel absorbeer?
items.explain: Fungi have chitin cell walls and absorb food from their surroundings.
items.explainAf: Swamme het chitien-selwande en absorbeer voedsel uit hul omgewing.

items.q: Which feature is typical of plants, and not of animals or fungi?
items.qAf: Watter kenmerk is tipies van plante, en nie van diere of swamme nie?
items.explain: Plants make their own food by photosynthesis (autotrophs). Animals and fungi are heterotrophs.
items.explainAf: Plante maak hul eie voedsel deur fotosintese (outotrofe). Diere en swamme is heterotrofe.

items.q: A student finds a single-celled organism with a nucleus that moves with cilia. Which kingdom is most likely?
items.qAf: ’n Leerder vind ’n eensellige organisme met ’n kern wat met silia beweeg. Watter koninkryk is die mees waarskynlik?
items.explain: Protists are mostly single-celled eukaryotes, and some move with cilia or flagella.
items.explainAf: Protiste is meestal eensellige eukariote, en sommige beweeg met silia of flagella.
